publicReleaseNotes: Buoy 0.1.5 opens the hosted demo with sample renewal data, updates the Business agent door on Run Edit Run 0.2.144, and supports deployment with outbound email turned off and owner sign-in through rer signin.
agentUpdateInstructions: Back up and exercise a restored copy first. Update to v0.1.5 and run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, then rer setup locally or rer deploy --environment <name> hosted with the same environment to apply the additive relay migration. Use the pinned Run Edit Run 0.2.144 toolchain. Deployments with MAIL_PROVIDER=none use rer signin for owner access.
